provenance: Original framework implementation based on Multiplayer 8a13602 source and exact-build static ABI evidence.

additional_native_facts.fact: Returns packed native CharacterTypeID with kind in the low 32 bits and global index in the high 32 bits; binds the new type to its collection and sends NewCharacterTypeCreated.
Does not read its receiver; allocates 0x360 bytes and invokes mmoNotificationPane's default constructor.
Initializes the TextPane base and the notification address point at image+0x171f240.
Retains the raw localization string at +0x2c8; an unparented pane skips layout callbacks.
The success branch emits {design_character_prefab_import_success} through CharacterPrefabsView::SetImportMessage after native definition adoption, user notifications and release effects.
Requires a non-null type. Rebuilds its current base/variant binding and child design panes; never use it to restore a previously null selection.
Activates MultiView page general_edit_name before filling the native text editor. Hidden inactive editor text is not proof of unsaved input.
